description: High-density residential district (non-contextual, without letter suffix). Either Quality Housing optional or Height Factor regulations apply. Wide street vs narrow street configurations affect FAR. Tower regulations per §23-435.

bulk.far_note: Within 100 ft of wide street: FAR 7.20 standard / 8.64 qualifying. Beyond 100 ft (narrow street): FAR 6.02 standard / 7.20 qualifying. Height Factor alternative available.

height_setback.regulation_type: Quality Housing (optional) OR Height Factor / Sky Exposure Plane (alternative)

height_factor_sky_exposure.notes: Height Factor buildings: height factor = floor area / lot coverage. Sky exposure plane slope: 2.5:1 in R8. Tower permitted per §23-435 in non-contextual R8.

height_setback.street_wall_setback_wide_st: 10 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_setback_narrow_st: 15 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.notes: Non-contextual R8 — most flexible district. Quality Housing or Height Factor options available. Tower regulations apply.

rear.through_lot_alternative: Rear yard equivalent per §23-343 on through lots ≥180 ft

permitted_uses.parking: Parking not permitted in front yard

dob_filing_notes: First determine street configuration (wide vs narrow) — affects FAR and height
Quality Housing vs Height Factor analysis required for building envelope
Tower regulations §23-435 available in non-contextual R8 — enables tall slender towers
If in Manhattan CD9 (north of W 125th St): special provisions per §23-442 apply
DOB NOW: NB or Alt1. Height Factor requires OSR calculation
